pixel_description: Photorealistic cutaway of white box cold room with front white hinged door on left wall, tilted dark-blue PV array on 4 grey steel posts sitting directly on room roof with sun glare on panels, interior shows left long 3-tier steel rack with green/brown vented crates full of produce, right short 3-tier rack with crates, rear white tank with blue water, ceiling silver evaporator box with copper pipes to right wall, exterior right wall has wall-mounted fan condenser box with black cables/pipes running down to small grey wall box and to larger grey double-door cabinet, front concrete slab with water puddle and drain grate, light-blue loop arrows on floor showing air circulation from rear to crates. Visible labels exactly as spelled: 'A', 'Tilted roof monocrystalline PV array', 'PU insulated cold room', 'insulated hinged door with gaskets', 'ice-bank', 'DC vapour-compression cooler', 'LiFePO4 battery bank', 'MPPT charge controller', 'LiFePO4-compression cooler' on two lines at bottom right, '~1000 mm', 'Conceptual illustration - physical performance not established'. Physical connections seen: posts carry PV above room, black electrical cables from PV edge down wall to small box then to large cabinet, copper pipes from ceiling unit through wall to condenser, door hinged on room, airflow arrows from ice/cooler area across crates.
label_findings: Labels not ok. Text 'LiFePO4-compression cooler' at lower right is garbled and conflates P5 battery bank with P2 cooler. Leader 'LiFePO4 battery bank' points to the wall-mounted finned fan condenser unit which is part of the DC cooler, not the battery cabinet. Leader 'DC vapour-compression cooler' points to the steel canopy post / roof edge, not to the ceiling evaporator or wall condenser. Other texts spelled correctly but P10 separate canopy and P11 wash slab have no correct label in render.

requirements.detail: All 11 parts modeled but P10 not separate and P11 unlabeled, and P4/P5 vs P2 identities confused by misplaced leaders
Posts carry PV, black cables PV to wall box to cabinet, copper pipes cooler to room, door on room, blue airflow ice/cooler to room all modeled
PV ~2x room width, room dominant 2000-2600mm class, cabinet/ice-bank 300-800mm small, crates 226-600mm small vs racks, matches size classes
Sun glare on PV, 1000kg produce in crates on twin racks, ice water in bank and blue circulating airflow from cooler/ice across crates show cooling operation
Thermal cooler-to-room path shown by blue airflow loop, but electrical PV->MPPT->battery->cooler path only by black cables with no energy flow overlay and obscured by wrong battery/cooler labels

s1_differences: LABEL: garbled 'LiFePO4-compression cooler' conflates battery and cooler; 'LiFePO4 battery bank' leader points to condenser not battery cabinet; 'DC vapour-compression cooler' leader points to canopy post not evaporator/condenser. Otherwise parts match but P10 canopy shown as posts on roof not separate footings with vent gap, and P11 wash slab visible as front concrete slab but unlabeled.
s2_feedback: No concrete design flaw exposed. Apparent canopy-on-roof and battery/cooler confusion are depiction/label placement faults in the render, not evidence that the sketched separate canopy, 11.25kWh bank, ice-bank or cooler sizing is functionally wrong.
notes: Render is photorealistic cutaway isometric with scale bar ~1000 mm and disclaimer 'Conceptual illustration - physical performance not established'. Electrical cables and copper pipes are modeled but identities confused by misplaced leaders. Front concrete slab with water is present visually as wash slab but unlabeled. Right small rack is foreshortened by cutaway perspective, not a size fault.
